segments.text: “Hell no I’m not doing that shit. Sounds like too much of a pain in the ass.”

Kaito is the protagonist of our story. He first comes into appearance as a first-year cadet in Ren’Ou, hailing from unknown origins. His preference of being alone, lack of seriousness towards his job, and the refusal of making any friends hasn’t done him any favors with the other young cadets at the training academy.

He’s bottom of the barrel in terms of his academic performance, but he intentionally positions himself like that so as not to draw too much attention to himself—in reality, he is academically superior to all of his peers. He’s curious and always eager to learn new things, and he trains when he knows no one is watching.
Hobbies: He likes to spend his free time reading.
Special Skill: Will eat anything and everything, as well as being proficient with some “unconventional” skills such as lockpicking and others.
Likes: Food that normal people would eat—curry, meat, and potato stew…
Dislikes: Standing out, and hates Santa Claus with a burning passion.
From Daybreak Translations
「ボディーガード訓練校」に入学した本編の主人公。
出身不明、不真面目、無愛想、孤独を愛することから、仲間の間での評判はよろしくない。
成績も下の下だが、実際は手を抜いているだけで、自ら意欲的に学んだことは、絶対に忘れない。
過去に重い罪を幾つか持っているようで……？
「断る。断固として断る。面倒なことはやりたくない」
本作品的主人公，一年前入学护卫培训学校的出身不明的学生。
孤独，马虎，冷淡的性格导致在学生中间的评价不好。
成绩也是在下等的下等，但是实际上只是手下留情而已。
学习能力超群的高，想要学到的东西从来不会忘记，实际上也悄悄地锻炼着筋力。
本来就是属于很少开口的类型，来到热闹的二阶堂家后，慢慢变化了。
主人公是一个背后隐藏着过去几重罪的成熟青年。
“You want me to choose someone who’s actually competent and serious about protecting me? The very thought of it makes me feel like vomiting.”

The eldest daughter of the Nikaidous, one of Japan’s most prominent families. She considers herself a “flawless” person. She doesn’t really like company in general, especially when it comes to her house’s butlers and bodyguards. However, she seems to have taken a liking to Kaito, who’s anything but serious at his job—so much so, in fact, that she forced him to stay at Ren’Ou just so he could become her bodyguard.

She’s always at the top of her class, and she definitely has a bright future ahead of her, but she hates having her path laid before her by others, and would like to make her own decisions someday. She hates her own height and bust size, and any references to either makes her pretty angry.
Hobbies: Listening to music, training her pets.
Special Skill: All-rounder.
Likes: Her pets.
Dislikes: Any references to her height or bust size.
From Daybreak Translations
日本でも有数の資産家“二階堂財閥”の長女。
「完璧なお嬢様」と称されるが、傍に他人を置くことを極端に嫌い、執事だけでなく、護衛の人間ですら拒絶する。
全てにおいてトップの座に君臨する彼女だが、性根はひねくれ曲がっていて、二階堂の檻から抜け出したいと思っている様子。
胸が小さいことと背が低いことがコンプレックス。
「自分の地位や、優秀で生真面目であることを誇りにするボディーガードを傍におくこと？　そんなの、ヘドが出るだけね」
背が低いことと貧乳であること以外完璧なお嬢さま。
お嬢さまの中でも比較的まともな人格者ではあるが、容赦ない毒舌と突っ込みは他のお嬢さまの追随を許さない。
「あんたは私のボディーガードでしょうが」
在日本为数不多的大财阀二階堂集团的长女，称之为完美千金的少女。
有极端讨厌其他人靠近自己倾向，而且不仅是管家，甚至是护卫也非常抗拒。
但是也有例外，非常喜欢直言不讳的主人公，强硬请了准备退学的主人公当作保镖。
由于自身本寄予了维持家族最高财力的愿望，结果本人萌发出脱离这个笼子的想法。
最在意的事情是胸部小与身高低。要是一不小心踩上了尾巴就会被毫不留情地咬一口。
“I hope we keep having this great weather throughout the rest of today, and hopefully tomorrow as well.”
Aya is Reika’s younger twin sister. She’s prim and proper, her mannerisms and looks befitting more closely the ideal standard of what a Lady would look and act like, more so than her sister.

Her stature and physical traits have made people confuse her as the eldest sister compared to Reika more than once. However, she has very low self-esteem, and has an inferiority complex towards Reika, who is an over-achiever in comparison to her.
She hasn’t talked with anyone of the opposite sex close to her age, so whenever she finds herself in front of other men, she has difficulties speaking to them.
Hobbies: Aya really likes taking walks, and secretly (or not so secretly) likes to play videogames
Likes: Aya really likes animals.
Dislikes: It’s not that she dislikes men, but Aya has a really hard time dealing with the opposite sex in a general sense.
From Daybreak Translations
麗華の双子の妹で、お淑やかで清楚な少女。
姉とは別のベクトルで、お嬢様としての要素を兼ねそろえている。
体型や物腰は大人びているが、自分に自信がないようで、何でもこなす姉に少しコンプレックスを抱いている様子。
異性と話す免疫がなく、男性との話は言葉に詰まることも少なくない。
趣味のテレビゲームは、引っ込み事案で内気な彼女が見つけた些細な楽しみの一つ。
「今日も明日も、ぽかぽかの天気が続けばいいですね」
お嬢さまらしいお嬢さまなのだが、ちょっと薄い。
隠れてゲームや漫画を大量に集めており、趣味としている。
出会った当初から海斗に惹かれている彼女は、いつも視線で海斗を追ってはため息をつく。
「影が薄いのだけは嫌です、前面に、出るんですっ」
麗華的双生子妹妹。安详而清秀，跟姐姐不一样具备了千金小姐的其他要素的少女。
体形和言谈都像个大人样子，也经常被别人误以为是姐姐。
只是自己没有什么自信，无论做什么事情都有比姐姐差的自卑感。
还有对异性没有免疫能力，经常说着说着就梗住不敢说下去。
偷偷的收藏着被禁止的电视游戏，突击畏缩不前怕羞的彩也是一种不错的消遣。
由于没有什么体力所以一般都是乘车上学的，不过也挺喜欢散步的。
“We’re gonna be in the same class this year, Reika. We’ll finally duke it out to see who’s the most excellent Lady!”

Tae is the sole daughter of one of the most prominent and wealthy families in all of Japan, the Kurayashikis. Because she feels the need to have a rival, she eventually decides to make Reika her nemesis, though this is a one-way relationship because Reika doesn’t play along with her.

Though Tae is prideful and leaves a strong impression wherever she goes like Reika does, she lacks the composure and patience Reika possesses, making her impulsive and, most of the time, irrational in the face of adversity. She’s also a very spoiled girl, making her prone to throw temper tantrums when things don’t go her way.

If you thought Aya had terrible physical resilience, then Tae is just on another level of weakness—just a few steps at a walking pace is enough to tire her. She’s also, for the lack of a better word, very dumb, and is the last of her class when it comes to scores, and not by a small margin either.
She’s not very accomplished in life, which is a little sad, but she’s always in good spirits.
Hobbies: Tae doesn’t really have any hobbies in particular.
Likes: Tae likes herself, and maybe a little too much to be healthy for her.
Dislikes: As her self-proclaimed rival, Tae dislikes Reika, but her reasons are pretty nonsensical. She also doesn’t like it when things don’t go the way she wants them to.
From Daybreak Translations
日本有数の資産家の令嬢で、麗華をライバル視するお嬢様。
豪快さと自信家なところは麗華に匹敵するが、いかんせん能力が追いついておらず、思ったままに行動し、しかも、思うようにいかないと途端に暴れ出すという厄介ぶり。
特に長所もなく、ドジな面も多いちょっとかわいそうな子だが、甘えん坊で一途な所もあるため、憎めない存在。
「木に気と書いて本気よ。うん、間違いない！」
天才の母を持ちながら、バカの称号を欲しいままにするお嬢さま。
何よりも頑張ること、努力することが嫌いで苦手。
相手より優位なことを見つけると、調子に乗ってそこばかり主張する。
「うーん、私の才能はまだ開花しないんじゃないかな？」
视麗華为竞争对手的日本屈指可数的资产家千金。
虽然跟爽快与自信的麗華性格非常相似，但缺少了沉着与冷静总是随意行动的类型。
要是不按照她的意思就会闹起来，不过这也是因为在缺少家庭温暖的家庭里长大的缘故。
运动能力甚至超过了彩，稍微走一下就累因此让人非常担心的身体。
头脑也不好而且还是在学校里数一数二的差。完全没有任何特长，而且经常好心做坏事的可怜孩子。虽然平时总是嫌三嫌四的，但是也有时会撒娇结果让人讨厌不了的少女
“Sir Kaito, understand that my duties and standing as a maid differ from those you have as a bodyguard.”

Tsuki works as the head maid at the Nikaidou estate. She’s someone who barely shows any emotion and always stays calm in the face of any situation. She has many nicknames, coined after her numerous “heroic” cleaning-related deeds, such as “Tsuki, the Undirtied Breaker of Stains, Queen of the Andals and the First Maids, and Protector of the Seven Cleandoms,” or the most commonly used, “The Sweeping Hand.”

She partakes in many comedic and improvised sketches with Kaito whenever the two are alone together. Her openness to make dirty jokes and nonchalant attitude towards conversational topics most women would consider gross makes her the only person capable of intimidating Kaito to a certain degree.

She doesn’t realize this, but she has a very weak presence, making her very hard to detect by normal people, to the point of being able to sneak into people’s rooms without having anyone inside those rooms notice.
Hobbies: Tsuki enjoys those special moments when she can wipe windows clean.
Likes: Tsuki loves anything related to cleaning, and seeing the fruits of her labor makes her very happy.

Dislikes: Tsuki hates when trash is lingering around the estate, or when people throw things on the floor expecting her to clean up after them. There’s nothing more infuriating for her than the very act of dirtying a space she worked on.
From Daybreak Translations
“二階堂家”のメイド長を勤める優秀な少女。
特に掃除にかけては凄まじく「掃除姫」「スイーパーハンド」などと呼ばれる。
ボディーガードとなった海斗としばしば漫才（？）のような掛け合いをするが、海斗に使えと言われれば、エロい単語や汚い言葉も平然と使う度胸と根性の持ち主で、海斗すら引かせることもある。
自覚はないが「希薄な気配」を持っていて、部屋に侵入しても気づかれないことも。
「それでは、三食よりもスカトロ大好き、日本汚物代表の海斗さま、失礼いたします」
幼い頃より二階堂でメイドを務める少女。
海斗との絶妙な漫才を幾度と繰り返し、今では目と目を合わせるだけでネタ漫才が可能らしい。
ただし、いきなり真面目モードになったりすることもある。
「よろしくお願いします。メイドの鏡、ツキちゃんです」
平时大多是保持着冷静与无感情状态。虽然比海斗小一岁却担任着二階堂家女仆长的优秀少女。
在清扫方面可以称得上是专家，再加上手部动作的高速因此被称作『掃除姫』『スイーパーハンド』等。
要是周围变得凌乱的话就会生气。名字也只有ツキ，连汉字也是不明。
在作品中跟海斗经常像是相声一样，对海斗有胆量和勇气用着工口单词与猥琐单词，因此非常吸引海斗。
再次虽然本人没有觉察实际上自己是拥有超越常人的隐藏气息能力，经常房间被入侵了也没有觉察。
这个好像跟过去有点关系吧……
“Those Okonomiyaki look… so tasty…”
Moe is a master martial artist, specializing in her family’s own-developed style of fighting, the Kanzaki Style.

Moe never was much of a conversationalist, and rarely does she engage in a conversation. This has made everyone around her keep her at an arm’s length, and no one who considers her a close friend either. Moe does, however, have real weaknesses, like her lack of knowledge about the outside world, and her childish approach to problem-solving in real-life situations.
Apart from that, Moe loves eating. She especially likes onigiri, natto, and okonomiyaki; all staples of a Japanese diet.

Though she looks emotionless, Moe feels strongly about what happens around her, especially towards people who are having a hard time. Though she wants to help out of kindness, sometimes this habit of poking her nose into other people’s business to help them goes a little too far. In fact, since she’s always lived in luxury, this has caused her many problems whenever she’s faced with situations where she’s exposed to the harsh reality that not everyone in the world has the same lifestyle that she’s always taken for granted.
Likes: Moe likes eating more than anything else, and the sight of her favourite foods can make her drool a river. She also has special fondness for those who she deems as strong.

Dislikes: On the other hand, Moe doesn’t really like those who she considers as weak, as well as people who can’t stop talking. She especially doesn’t like witnessing things that are contrary to her ideal of “justice,” such as people suffering.
From Daybreak Translations
古武術を極める天才格闘お嬢様。
無口で滅多に喋ることはなく、また圧倒的な強さも相まって、周囲から敬遠されることも少なくない。
しかし、ポケポケしている部分も多く、間の抜けた行動も多々ある。
おにぎりや納豆、お好み焼きなど、お嬢様らしからぬモノを好んで食し、困っている人にお節介を焼くなど、身分の差というものをあまり理解していない様子。
「……お好み焼き……美味しそう……」
持ち前の運動神経と武道家としての才能は、ボディーガードを志す男たちよりも一枚上の実力を持つ。
しかし普段はぼけっとしていて、周囲がそのマイペースについていけず慌ててしまうことも多い。
暴飲暴食が大好き。
「海斗と、一度本気で手合わせをしてみたい……」
古武术登峰造极的天才格斗少女。平时都是沉默寡言很少说话。
被那个压倒性的力量吓得敬而远之的事情也不少，结果导致可爱的名字完全没有人敢称。
实际上也有非常糊涂的地方，而且是很多。
总而言之就是喜欢吃东西，尤其是不适合女孩子的东西特别喜欢。（饭团，纳豆，章鱼烧等）
而且意外的热血，看到困难的人就会上去帮忙。对于身份的差异完全不理解，因此常常因为这个而造成了非常多的麻烦。
“Pfft, like I care about what you think of me.”

She’s the sole daughter of the Kokudou family. She’s very prideful, maybe a tad too much, just like Reika and Tae, though Kyouka is definitely less subtle about reminding her peers of her superiority at Ren’Ou and everywhere else.
Kyouka has a tendency of wanting to stand out whenever she can, and she won’t forgive those who don’t obey her every whim.
Hobbies: She loves putting herself on a pedestal whenever possible.
Likes: Kyouka likes it when things go her way, as well as partaking in events befitting of her social status.
Dislikes: Kyouka dislikes bad smells, dirtiness, and lack of self care from people around her.
From Daybreak Translations
麗華に負けず、好き勝手やり放題のお嬢さま。
恋愛小説に非常に興味を持っていて、生きがいとしている。
護衛役の雷太には常々厳しくあたっていて、容赦なく足技を繰り出すことから、運動神経も良いと思われる。
「おーっほっほっほ！　とか、そんな笑い方しませんわよ」
黒堂家的独生女。虽然在完全不听别人的意见上跟麗華很相似，但是却一点也不可爱。
不允许违背自己的存在，非常讨厌不顺从自己的人。
常常想着怎么出风头。
“I definitely recommend Kaito to be your bodyguard, my Lady. As you can see he’s quite the resilient individual.”
Satake used to be a bodyguard of the Nikaidou family (Genzou’s to be exact). Now he spends his days as the headmaster of Ren’Ou Academy.

He’s completely bald, his skin somewhat tanned, and has a personality and looks that could scare more than one passerby. Don’t let his looks deceive you, though, as Satake has a natural predisposition to judge other people’s character like no other, and has an extraordinary skill to empathise with others.
He’s always wearing sunglasses, so it’s almost impossible to know what he feels or what he’s thinking about by reading his eyes.
Satake is the only person who knows everything about Kaito’s past.
Hobbies: Though Satake may have hobbies, these are completely unknown to us.
Likes: Satake has always a soft spot for children, as well as having his occasional smoke or glass of whisky whenever he has some time for himself.
Dislikes: What Satake hates more than anything is people lacking the willpower and guts to carry things through to the end.
From Daybreak Translations
“And you’re supposed to be a bodyguard?! Watch your tongue when talking to your betters, you punk!”

Genzou is Reika’s and Aya’s father. He’s a strict father and someone who likes people who match his seriousness like Takanori. On the other hand, he really hates people like Kaito, who lacks respect towards him and resolution towards his job.
It’s easy for him to get in a fit of rage over the smallest of things, and this has caused lots of incidents where he’s fired his entire estate’s workforce because of it.

Though he dislikes Kaito, eventually he gets closer to him thanks to his reading hobby and his favorite story genres being the same ones Kaito likes, to the point of them exchanging books between each other.
Hobbies: Just like Kaito, Genzou enjoys the company of books and reading.
Likes: Genzou loves eating his favorite foods, especially his favorite meat, Wagyu beef from the Ohta region.
Dislikes: Genzou doesn’t like unruly youngsters, especially those that don’t treat him with the respect he feels like he deserves.
From Daybreak Translations
“You? Lady Reika’s bodyguard? Preposterous.”

Takanori graduated from the first year of the bodyguard cadets as the first of his promotion. Though he has a tendency to toot his horn a little too much, Takanori can definitely back up his cockiness with his deeds and actual capabilities and strength.

His objective ever since he started as a cadet was to become Lady Reika’s bodyguard, but having someone he’d consider lousy at best, that being Kaito, sweep the rug out from under him and easily steal from him what he worked so hard for makes Takanori hate him.

Though his name is Takanori everyone calls him “Son,” which is the most common reading of the first kanji of his name (尊). In fact, at first many people confused his name with “Sontoku,” as the true readings of his name’s kanjis are quite particular and difficult to guess at first sight (尊徳).
His lack of experience with girls altogether can make even the slightest of arousing situations provoke nosebleeds, such as the mere thought of holding hands with Reika.
Hobbies: Takanori loves playing soccer.
Likes: Takanori has a soft spot for anything related to fencing.
Dislikes: If there’s anything Takanori hates, it’s Kaito for sure.
From Daybreak Translations
“You’re actually the only one in our year that I actually respect, you know, Kaito?”

He may look like a normal guy on the outside, but Yuuki is actually an android, the latest creation of the Kurayashiki Industries. His appearance and his obsession with girls, along with his aloof personality contributes to making him feel more human than other people.
Any terminology related to the destruction of software can make Yuuki fume in anger, in a very literal sense too, if you know what we mean…
Hobbies: Whenever he’s not too busy, Yuuki likes ogling at every girl he comes across.
Likes: He loves spending time with girls, listening to girls, talking about girls… Basically, he likes girls.
Dislikes: Terminology related to computer hacking and any sort of malware, virus, or trojan.
“I’m not going back home until Kaito comes along with us!”
Akiko is Tae’s mother. She’s 42 years old, though she acts more childish than her age would suggest—Whenever things don’t go her way she makes a habit of throwing terrible temper tantrums.
She’s also the president of Kurayashiki Industries, as well as the engineer who created Yuuki, her first sentient android.
Hobbies: Whenever she has some free time for herself, Akiko likes gardening.
Likes: Cleanliness, and pretty boys.
Dislikes: Whatever lacks technological advancement.
From Daybreak Translations
“Moe is nothing but my cute, sexy, and beautiful kitten!”

Dengorou is Moe’s grandfather, and a master of the ancient martial art called the Kanzaki Style. He surpasses Moe in skill greatly, but the years are starting to get to him. He’s hard with everyone around him and himself, but he has a very sweet spot for Moe.
Seeing Kaito become friendly with Moe rubs him the wrong way.
Hobbies: He’s wholeheartedly devoted to his martial arts training
Likes: Dengorou loves to fight with other people.
Dislikes: People that lack guts, and men that get too close to his granddaughter Moe.
From Daybreak Translations
“Ahhhhh! You broke my figurine’s arm!”
Raita is a hardcore otaku, completely devoted to his figurines and anime series.

His father was a bodyguard, and though that made Raita reluctant to follow in his steps, he was in the end forced to follow the same path over at Ren’Ou. Raita keeps his scores high for his parents to continue allowing him to keep his hobbies. Though he may not be the most good-looking guy, Raita is actually one of the top students of his promotion, both in physical and academic terms, only second to Takanori and Kaoru.
His dream in life is to become an anime figurine craftsman.
Hobbies: Whenever he is able to, Raita watches every anime series in existence.
Likes: Anime, 2D women.
Dislikes: Nothing revolts Raita more than the mere existence of 3D women, or should we say, hates the 3D world in general.
From Daybreak Translations

Sonata and Kanata are the two cheetahs that Reika keeps in her room as pets. They look pretty much identical and on the outside they’re cute, but don’t let their cuteness fool you, because whoever they deem as an enemy of theirs or Reika’s will be torn to pieces without mercy.

Reika is their one and only master. Her anger can cause them distress, and her praise can grant great happiness to them. Reika intends to have them as her bodyguards once they grow up. Sonata is more impulsive, while Kanata is the more sensible of the two.
From Daybreak Translations

Sonata and Kanata are the two cheetahs that Reika keeps in her room as pets. They look pretty much identical and on the outside they’re cute, but don’t let their cuteness fool you, because whoever they deem as an enemy of theirs or Reika’s will be torn to pieces without mercy.

Reika is their one and only master. Her anger can cause them distress, and her praise can grant great happiness to them. Reika intends to have them as her bodyguards once they grow up. Sonata is more impulsive, while Kanata is the more sensible of the two.
From Daybreak Translations
“I must become a bodyguard, no matter what!”

Kaoru graduated from the training academy with excellent scores, making him the second best in his promotion after Takanori. He was also Kaito’s roommate for the entirety of their first year in the academy together. Kaoru excels at combat whenever he carries his wooden sword or a melee weapon with him, but he’s not very good at hand-to-hand combat in return. He is proud of his status as a bodyguard and likes his job, which has made him clash with Kaito multiple times, as he doesn’t exactly share the same sentiment as Kaoru does. Nevertheless, Kaoru and Kaito are good friends.
Kaoru’s family has been one of proficient bodyguards for generations, which pressures him to train and push himself to his absolute limits, sometimes exceeding his own possibilities.
Kaoru has a tendency of pretending to be tough, and hates exposing any sort of opening or weakness in front of others, even if he trusts them.
Hobbies: Kaoru spends all of his available free time training, which he likes doing.
Likes: Kaoru likes his job more than anything else, protecting his clients.
Dislikes: Kaoru hates being treated as a girl, even though he’s clearly a guy.
From Daybreak Translations
“You’ve changed, Kaito.”
Anzu is a woman who has grown up in a very rough environment, making her mannerisms resemble those of a man, and having a tough exterior. Deep inside though, Anzu is a kind and innocent girl.
She’s on the lookout for Kaito, who disappeared from her life one year ago, and is now working as Kyouka’s bodyguard in order to survive on “the other side” while she looks for him.
Hobbies: Anzu doesn’t have any particular hobbies.
Likes: Anzu doesn’t really have anything that she likes in particular.
Dislikes: What Anzu dislikes more than anything though is being left alone.
From Daybreak Translations
“What do you guys think is the most important quality a bodyguard should have?”

An accomplished graduate who just recently joined Ren’Ou academy as one of their teaching staff. This is her second year as an educator, and she’s the tutor for Kaito’s class.. She’s had several male students confess their feelings to her, but so far she’s managed to turn each and every single of them down with grace.
Though she may not appear like she’s capable of much, Akemi has more than one ace hidden under her sleeve, and could most likely give most of her students a run for their money if she so wished.
Hobbies: Akemi spends her free time expanding her never-ending collection of pocket tissues.
Likes: Akemi has a soft spot for her students, as well as fantasizing about what the future has in store for her.
Dislikes: Nothing in particular.
From Daybreak Translations
